To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The Propp model of plot structure can be usefully applied to the analysis of narrative discourse, but that (2) the Propp model needs to be refined and expanded, and (3) the Proppian model of plot structure should be used to analyze narrative discourse, not as an alternative to the traditional analysis, but as a supplement to it, as an additional tool that can be used to analyze and understand the narrative.
(1) The Propp model of narrative analysis, as developed by David Herman, is not a valid method for analyzing filmic texts.

In summary, our research is concerned with

the development, refinement and testing of an approach designed to relate the Proppian model of plot structure to a particular narrative discourse, namely, the screenplay for Martin McDonagh's In Bruges (2008) The film is a comedy crime film set in the Belgian city of Bruges.
the development and application of a neo Proppyian analysis of narrative structure.

the question of how to identify and describe the units of analysis that constitute the ideal form of the text in terms of the Proppian model, and how to translate these units of analysis into the discourse forms of the film.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the units of a Neo Proppian plot function analysis are those units of the text that contain significant semantic meaning.
the Proppian model does not describe the text but rather the plot of the text.
the neo Proppian model is a means of describing a text that has a specific narrative function in relation to other texts.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Propp's functions can be identified in a variety of forms in a wide range of narrative texts.
the neo Proppian approach to narrative analysis is a useful tool for the analysis of the plot of a narrative.
the Proppian functions are a means to an end; they are a way of identifying the key elements of a story.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Proppian analysis is not a text grammatical analysis.
Proppian functions can be identified in any narrative text and can be used as a means of describing that text's structure.
the concept of the function of the plot can be successfully applied to filmic discourse, but only when it is redefined as a concept of a particular type of discourse function.
